newsitem.title: UK: Capital Radio up after director purchase.
newsitem.headline: Capital Radio up after director purchase.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Capital Radio Plc rebounded from recent sharp losses on Wednesday as the company said Henderson Financial Management increased its stake and managing director Richard Eyre and his wife bought 2,138 shares.
The stock was up 16p at 561-1/2 by 1201 GMT in thin trading of 50,838 shares.

Capital Radio shares tumbled earlier this month after the company said it was branching out with the 51 million stg purchase of theme restaurant operator My Kinda Town -- a move which received a negative reaction in the market.
The stock hit a ten-month low of 535p on November 14.
Capital said today Henderson Financial Management had bought 111,000 shares at 545p, taking its stake to 3.1 million or 4.24 percent.
